title: claudex checkpoint review artifact, version 1
description: The pair's review of an implemented step at a checkpoint: an agree/revise verdict, code-level findings, and a judgement on test adequacy. Submitted for a checkpoint phase.

protocol_version.description: The protocol major version; always 1 for this schema.

message_type.description: Discriminates this message from other protocol messages.

turn_id.description: The turn this review is submitted for.

state_revision.description: The run-state revision this submit must compare-and-swap against.

human_context.description: Optional free-text context for the human; null when none.

requires_human_decision.description: True only for an unresolved value choice or repeated evidence-backed disagreement.

decision_question.description: The concrete question for the human, else null.

verdict.description: Whether the reviewer agrees with the step or requires a revision.

file.description: Repository-relative file the finding references, or null.

line.description: Line the finding references, or null.

tests_adequate.description: Whether the tests accompanying the step are adequate.
